description: This file declares exported API functions for a Byte Array component, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions, specifically for use in a component-based system for the BroadWay Service Delivery System.

methods.name: AnscCreateByteArrayComponent
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Byte Array component, returning its handle using provided container, owner, and reserved context handles.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Byte Array component, returning its handle conditioned on passed context handles.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayCORemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the Byte Array component instance associated with the provided handle.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers internal objects needed by the Byte Array component instance.

methods.name: AnscByteArrayCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Byte Array component instance to a ready state.
